title: Centerline Boundary Dice Loss for Vascular Segmentation (cbDice)
mechanism: clDice extended with boundary and radius-normalised skeleton terms to balance thin and thick branches.
adaptation: Crack radius is about 1 px, so on crack cbDice is close to clDice (which failed here). The only distinct use is multi-class balancing of thick inactive / ribbons against thin crack / gridline (beta 0.5 to 1 for 2D).
min_experiment: Arm: PF + cbDice over crack, gridline and inactive, 3 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: gridline and inactive IoU. Kill if neither gains 0.02.
evidence: R (full text): DRIVE 2D Dice 82.5 (best), gains under 1 point over clDice. TopCoW small-artery Dice 43.4 vs 38.5 for clDice. R (TopoMortar): CrackTree Dice 0.76, no topology gain over CEDice.
prior_overlap: Close to soft clDice (failed, same conditions) on the crack class. Untested for multi-class width balance.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack radius is about 1 px everywhere, so on crack cbDice reduces to near clDice, which failed here. Only possible use is multi-class balance between thick (inactive, ribbons) and thin (crack, gridline) classes. Belongs in the benchmark suite as a standard baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark baseline only: PF + cbDice on crack and gridline, 5 seeds; kill if crack IoU < PF - 0.012.
